statement: An Equip Spell is activated by targeting 1 face-up monster it can equip, and is equipped to it as it resolves, keeping it as its target. It can equip any monster unless its text says which, and negating its effects doesn't lift that.

sources.where: Official Rulebook, version 10.0: Equip Spell Cards
sources.says: An Equip Spell Card is activated by choosing 1 face-up monster to equip, and stays on the field equipped to it.

scripts: The scripts write it with aux.AddEquipProcedure, and give the EQUIP_LIMIT a range (SINGLE_RANGE) on 18 Equip Spells that read.
